Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CMK governance & SOC2/GDPR follow-up

Thanks for the call this morning — quick recap and proposed next steps from our side. High level notes: 

- SOC 2: you mentioned a Type II in progress (expected Q3). Please confirm whether you need a completed report or a bridge letter for procurement.
- Regulatory: GDPR scope confirmed for EU users; you noted HIPAA requirements for a subset of customers.
- Encryption: Curelytics preference: customer-managed keys with HSM backing if possible. You brought up key rotation, split custody, and audit logs.
- Options we can offer: Redwood-managed KMS (fastest), Customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault (BYOK), or Private deployment with HSM integration for customers requiring on-prem keys. We also support envelope encryption and TLS in transit; at-rest encryption is AES-256.

Immediate asks from your team:
1) If you can share the vendor security questionnaire (or tell me which template you use), we will start filling it out.
2) Can you share a redacted network diagram and the list of compliance evidence you require (SOC2 report, penetration test, data flow maps)?
3) Which CCs should receive the vendor responses?

Tentative next steps: we will: (a) prep our standard KMS/CMK tech note and HSM integration checklist, (b) draft suggested answers for the questionnaire once received, and (c) confirm timelines for redaction/attestation.

I'm copying Aisha (security) and Neha (legal) to help with questionnaire intake and evidence.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@curelytics.com>

Thanks Marcus — good summary. Attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf). A few clarifications:

- SOC2: we are currently in the Type II attestation window; expected completion mid-Q3. For procurement, we usually accept a SOC2 Type II in-progress confirmation plus a recent control summary; a full report is preferred prior to contract signature.
- HIPAA: yes, we have PHI scoped customers. We require BAAs where PHI is in scope.
- Keys: our security team prefers customer-managed keys with HSM backing (FIPS 140-2 level 3 or equivalent). We also expect key rotation policies and proof of key lineage.
- Network diagram: we'll attach a redacted diagram where possible; full topology will follow under an NDA if needed.

Please start with the questionnaire and highlight fields where you need inputs from infra/security. Our security alias (security@curelytics.com) should be included on any evidence shares.

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Security, Curelytics Health
elena.rossi@curelytics.com
